rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?

  fba.ADDRESS_LINE_1 AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.CITY,

  fba.POSTAL_CODE
FROM fac_building fb
JOIN fac_building_address fba

    `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    `SESSION_LOCATION`,
    `SESSION_DATE`,
    `SESSION_START_TIME`,
    `SESSION_END_TIME`,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `iap_subject_session`
),
iap_subject_person_leaders AS (

    `PERSON_NAME`,
    `PERSON_EMAIL`,

rows.question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_subject_detail_clean AS (
  SELECT
    `iap_subject_detail`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY` AS `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY`,
    `iap_subject_detail`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` AS `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    -- canonicalize MAX_ENROLLMENT: numeric integer if possible, else NULL
    (CASE
      WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(`iap_subject_detail`.`MAX_ENROLLMENT`, '')) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN `iap_subject_detail`.`MAX_ENROLLMENT` REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(`iap_subject_detail`.`MAX_ENROLLMENT` AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS `MAX_ENROLLMENT`,
    -- canonicalize ATTENDANCE: numeric integer if possible, else NULL
    (CASE
      WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(`iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE`, '')) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN `iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE` REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(`iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE` AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS `ATTENDANCE`,
    -- canonicalize FEE: strip common symbols and parse decimal if possible
    (CASE
      WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(`iap_subject_detail`.`FEE`, '')) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(`iap_subject_detail`.`FEE`, ',', ''), '$', ''), 'USD', ''), 'usd', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
        THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(`iap_subject_detail`.`FEE`, ',', ''), '$', ''), 'USD', ''), 'usd', '') AS DECIMAL(18,4))
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS `FEE`,
    `iap_subject_detail`.`IS_CANCELLED` AS `IS_CANCELLED`,
    `iap_subject_detail`.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    `iap_subject_detail`.`ACTIVITY_TITLE` AS `ACTIVITY_TITLE`
  FROM `iap_subject_detail`
),
iap_subject_session_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    `iap_subject_session`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` AS `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    `iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_SEQUENCE` AS `SESSION_SEQUENCE`,
    `iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_TITLE` AS `SESSION_TITLE`,
    `iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_LOCATION` AS `SESSION_LOCATION`,
    `iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_DATE` AS `SESSION_DATE`,
    `iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_START_TIME` AS `SESSION_START_TIME`,
    `iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_END_TIME` AS `SESSION_END_TIME`,
    CASE
      WHEN `iap_subject_session`.`HAS_SESSION_INFO` IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`HAS_SESSION_INFO`) = '' THEN ''
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`HAS_SESSION_INFO`)) IN ('Y','YES','1','T','TRUE') THEN 'Y'
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`HAS_SESSION_INFO`)) IN ('N','NO','0','F','FALSE') THEN 'N'
      ELSE `iap_subject_session`.`HAS_SESSION_INFO`
    END AS `HAS_SESSION_INFO`
  FROM `iap_subject_session`
),
-- aggregate enrollment and fees per sponsor using cleaned detail rows
det AS (
  SELECT
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    -- TOTAL_ENROLLMENT: prefer ATTENDANCE when numeric, else MAX_ENROLLMENT; sum available numeric values
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN d.ATTENDANCE IS NOT NULL THEN d.ATTENDANCE
        WHEN d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL THEN d.MAX_ENROLLMENT
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
    -- MIN_FEE and MAX_FEE from numeric parsed FEE values (NULLs ignored)
    MIN(d.FEE) AS MIN_FEE,
    MAX(d.FEE) AS MAX_FEE
  FROM iap_subject_detail_clean AS d
  GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
),
-- compute session counts per sponsor by joining detail -> session (only sessions that exist in session table)
sess AS (
  SELECT
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS NUM_SESSIONS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sc.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SESSIONS_WITH_INFO,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sc.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SESSIONS_WITHOUT_INFO
  FROM iap_subject_detail_clean AS d
  JOIN iap_subject_session_canonical AS sc
    ON sc.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
)
SELECT
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS SPONSOR_NAME,
  COALESCE(sess.NUM_SESSIONS, 0) AS NUM_SESSIONS,
  COALESCE(det.TOTAL_ENROLLMENT, 0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  det.MIN_FEE AS MIN_FEE,
  det.MAX_FEE AS MAX_FEE,
  COALESCE(sess.SESSIONS_WITH_INFO, 0) AS SESSIONS_WITH_INFO,
  COALESCE(sess.SESSIONS_WITHOUT_INFO, 0) AS SESSIONS_WITHOUT_INFO
FROM iap_subject_sponsor AS s
LEFT JOIN det
  ON det.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN sess
  ON sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
WHERE s.SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.SPONSOR_NAME

rows.question: What is the term code, term description, total number of IAP sessions, total fee collected, and minimum and maximum enrollment for each term code?

WITH iap_subject_detail_clean AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    TRIM(TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    ENROLLMENT_TYPE,
    -- normalized MAX_ENROLLMENT as integer when possible
    CASE
      WHEN MAX_ENROLLMENT REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(MAX_ENROLLMENT AS SIGNED)
      WHEN MAX_ENROLLMENT REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR(CAST(MAX_ENROLLMENT AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS MAX_ENROLLMENT,
    -- keep ATTENDANCE raw for numeric test later
    TRIM(ATTENDANCE) AS ATTENDANCE,
    -- normalize FEE: strip common currency symbols and commas; produce NULL for non-numeric/empty
    CASE
      WHEN FEE IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(
        TRIM(
          REPLACE(
            REPLACE(
              REPLACE(
                REPLACE(REPLACE(FEE, '$', ''), 'USD', ''),
              '€', ''),
            ',', ''),
          '£', '')
        ), ''
      )
    END AS FEE,
    IS_CANCELLED
  FROM iap_subject_detail
),
-- derive term descriptions by joining distinct IAP TERM_CODEs to academic_terms (prefer academic_terms then academic_terms_all)
iap_term_reference AS (
  SELECT
    t.TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE
    FROM iap_subject_detail
    WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(TERM_CODE) <> ''
  ) t
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
    ON t.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all ata
    ON t.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
)
SELECT
  d.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  r.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_IAP_SESSIONS,
  -- sum FEE treating non-numeric (after cleaning) as zero: cast safe via REGEXP test
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN d.FEE IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN d.FEE REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(d.FEE AS DECIMAL(18,2))
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS TOTAL_FEE_COLLECTED,
  -- For enrollment: prefer numeric ATTENDANCE, otherwise use MAX_ENROLLMENT. Compute per-row chosen_enroll then aggregate min/max.
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN d.ATTENDANCE IS NOT NULL AND d.ATTENDANCE REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(FLOOR(CAST(d.ATTENDANCE AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS SIGNED)
      ELSE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT
    END
  ) AS MIN_ENROLLMENT,

      ELSE (

          WHEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_START_TIME`)),'.',':'),' ',''), '%l:%i%p') IS NOT NULL
            THEN TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_START_TIME`)),'.',':'),' ',''), '%l:%i%p'))/60
          WHEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_START_TIME`)),'.',':'),' ',''), '%k:%i') IS NOT NULL

          WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_START_TIME`)) BETWEEN 3 AND 4

            THEN (FLOOR(CAST(TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_START_TIME`) AS UNSIGNED)/100)*60 + (CAST(TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_START_TIME`) AS UNSIGNED)%100))

    CASE

      ELSE (

            THEN TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(`iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_END_TIME`)),'.',':'),' ',''), '%l:%i%p'))/60

LEFT JOIN (

  WHERE sr.BUILDING_COMPONENT IS NOT NULL AND sr.BUILDING_COMPONENT <> ''
  GROUP BY sr.BUILDING_COMPONENT

      su.MIT_ID,
      su.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES
    FROM space_supervisor_usage su
    JOIN space_detail_rooms r
      ON (
           -- try matching common supervisor table columns if present; check multiple possibilities
           (su.FAC_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND su.FAC_ROOM <> '' AND su.FAC_ROOM = r.SPACE_UNIT_KEY)
        OR (su.SUPERVISOR_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND su.SUPERVISOR_ROOM <> '' AND su.SUPERVISOR_ROOM = r.SPACE_UNIT_KEY)
        OR (su.FAC_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND su.FAC_ROOM <> '' AND su.FAC_ROOM = r.BUILDING_ROOM)
        OR (su.SUPERVISOR_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND su.SUPERVISOR_ROOM <> '' AND su.SUPERVISOR_ROOM = r.BUILDING_ROOM)
        OR (su.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL AND su.FAC_ROOM_KEY <> '' AND su.FAC_ROOM_KEY = r.SPACE_UNIT_KEY)
        OR (su.SUPERVISOR_KEY IS NOT NULL AND su.SUPERVISOR_KEY <> '' AND su.SUPERVISOR_KEY = r.SPACE_UNIT_KEY)
        OR (su.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL AND su.FAC_ROOM_KEY <> '' AND su.FAC_ROOM_KEY = r.BUILDING_ROOM)
        OR (su.SUPERVISOR_KEY IS NOT NULL AND su.SUPERVISOR_KEY <> '' AND su.SUPERVISOR_KEY = r.BUILDING_ROOM)

    WHERE r.BUILDING_COMPONENT IS NOT NULL AND r.BUILDING_COMPONENT <> ''
  ) ss
  GROUP BY ss.BUILDING_COMPONENT
) sup_counts
  ON sup_counts.BUILDING_COMPONENT = s.BUILDING_COMPONENT
WHERE s.BUILDING_COMPONENT IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY s.BUILDING_COMPONENT

rows.question: What are the details of courses offered in the current academic term, including the academic year, term code, hgn code, the total number of types of courses, the average number of units, the department name, the name and email address of the person in charge?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH current_academic_term AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`
  FROM `academic_terms`
  WHERE `IS_CURRENT_TERM` = 'Y'
)
SELECT
  cat.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  cat.TERM_CODE,
  so.HGN_CODE,
  -- count distinct course "types" using available type-like columns; fall back to STATUS_CHANGE or 'UNKNOWN'
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(so.GIR_ATTRIBUTE, so.HGN_CODE, so.GRADE_TYPE, so.STATUS_CHANGE, 'UNKNOWN')) AS TOTAL_TYPES_OF_COURSES,
  -- average of the available unit columns per row: compute per-row sum of unit columns then average across rows in the group
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(
      (COALESCE(so.TOTAL_UNITS,0)
       + COALESCE(so.LECTURE_UNITS,0)
       + COALESCE(so.LAB_UNITS,0)
       + COALESCE(so.PREPARATION_UNITS,0)
       + COALESCE(so.DESIGN_UNITS,0)) > 0
    ) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE AVG(
      NULLIF(
        (COALESCE(so.TOTAL_UNITS,0)
         + COALESCE(so.LECTURE_UNITS,0)
         + COALESCE(so.LAB_UNITS,0)
         + COALESCE(so.PREPARATION_UNITS,0)
         + COALESCE(so.DESIGN_UNITS,0)),
        0
      )
    )
  END AS AVERAGE_UNITS,
  -- prefer an explicit department name column, fall back to department code
  COALESCE(so.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- best-effort responsible faculty name (explicit field first, then directory full name)
  COALESCE(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME) AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  -- best-effort email: match by MIT_ID first (subject offered -> employee_directory), otherwise null
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL
FROM current_academic_term AS cat
JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered AS so
  ON so.TERM_CODE = cat.TERM_CODE
  -- only include rows with required identifiers
  AND so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND (so.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL OR so.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL)
  AND (so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL OR so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL)
LEFT JOIN employee_directory AS ed
  ON ed.MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
-- If MIT_ID missing but responsible faculty name present, attempt a best-effort match to employee_directory by name
LEFT JOIN employee_directory AS ed_name_match
  ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NULL
     AND ed_name_match.FULL_NAME = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
-- prefer email from MIT_ID match, otherwise from name match
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT MIT_ID, EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM employee_directory
) ed_pref ON ed_pref.MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
-- use COALESCE in select to prefer ed (by MIT_ID) then ed_name_match
GROUP BY
  cat.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  cat.TERM_CODE,
  so.HGN_CODE,
  COALESCE(so.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.DEPARTMENT_CODE),
  COALESCE(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME)
ORDER BY
  DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC,
  so.SUBJECT_ID ASC,
  so.SECTION_ID ASC

WITH tip_detail_rowlevel AS (

    `TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `tip_detail`

tip_material_raw AS (
  SELECT
    `TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    `YEAR`,
    `TITLE`,
    `ISBN`
  FROM `tip_material`
),

  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`,
    `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`
  FROM `tip_subject_offered`
)
SELECT
  s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  COALESCE(mats.total_materials, 0) AS TOTAL_MATERIALS,
  COALESCE(mats.total_subjects, 0) AS TOTAL_SUBJECTS,
  COALESCE(sch.total_schools, 0) AS TOTAL_SCHOOLS,
  -- return most recent year as string (NULL if none)
  CASE WHEN mr.max_year_numeric IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(mr.max_year_numeric AS CHAR) END AS MOST_RECENT_PUBLICATION_YEAR
FROM `tip_material_status` s
LEFT JOIN (
  -- per status: distinct materials and subjects counts
  SELECT
    d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects
  FROM tip_detail_rowlevel d
  WHERE d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
) mats
  ON mats.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- per status: most recent numeric publication year across linked materials
  SELECT
    d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    MAX(years.yr) AS max_year_numeric
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
    FROM tip_detail_rowlevel
    WHERE TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL
  ) d
  JOIN tip_material_raw tm ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
      CASE
        WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(`YEAR`, '')) REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,6}$' THEN CAST(`YEAR` AS SIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END AS yr
    FROM tip_material_raw
  ) years ON years.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
) mr
  ON mr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- per status: count distinct schools (prefer OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, fallback to OFFER_DEPT_NAME)
  SELECT
    d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ''), NULLIF(tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ''))) AS total_schools
  FROM (
    -- distinct subject+term pairs per status to avoid double-counting same subject across materials
    SELECT DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE
    FROM tip_detail_rowlevel
    WHERE SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  ) d
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered_school tso
    ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID
   AND tso.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
  GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
) sch
  ON sch.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
ORDER BY s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS

WITH fac_rooms_room_rows AS (

    `FLOOR`,
    `ROOM`,
    `FAC_ROOM_KEY`,
    `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
    `DEPT_CODE`
  FROM `fac_rooms`
  WHERE `BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
),
buildings_basic AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`
  FROM `buildings`
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  dept_mode.DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  dept_mode.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  -- highest/lowest floors: prefer numeric comparison when FLOOR parses as integer, otherwise fall back to string comparison
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN FLOOR REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR AS SIGNED) END) IS NOT NULL
    THEN CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN FLOOR REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR AS SIGNED) END) AS CHAR)
    ELSE MAX(FLOOR)
  END AS HIGHEST_FLOOR,
  CASE
    WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN FLOOR REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR AS SIGNED) END) IS NOT NULL
    THEN CAST(MIN(CASE WHEN FLOOR REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR AS SIGNED) END) AS CHAR)
    ELSE MIN(FLOOR)
  END AS LOWEST_FLOOR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fr.ROOM) AS TOTAL_ROOMS
FROM buildings_basic b
JOIN fac_rooms_room_rows fr
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- choose a representative (most frequent non-null) dept and organization per building
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(DEPT_CODE ORDER BY cnt DESC, DEPT_CODE SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS DEPT_CODE,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY cnt_org DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS ORGANIZATION_NAME
  FROM (
    SELECT
      BUILDING_KEY,
      DEPT_CODE,
      ORGANIZATION_NAME,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt_org
    FROM fac_rooms_room_rows
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, DEPT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME
  ) t
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) dept_mode
  ON dept_mode.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  dept_mode.DEPT_CODE,
  dept_mode.ORGANIZATION_NAME

    FROM fall_subject_offerings
  ) fso
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON ed.MIT_ID = fso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
  LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory ded
    -- if MIT_ID not available, attempt name match (case-sensitive as stored)
    ON (ded.MIT_ID = fso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID)
       OR (fso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NULL AND ded.FULL_NAME = fso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
),
-- For each instructor (keyed by MIT_ID when available else by name) count distinct subject titles in same fall TERM_CODE
subjects_per_instructor AS (
  SELECT
    inst_key,
    COUNT(*) AS subjects_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(fso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, fso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS inst_key,
      COALESCE(ccs.CANON_SUBJECT_TITLE, fso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS resolved_subject_title,

     AND ccs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = fso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    WHERE COALESCE(ccs.CANON_SUBJECT_TITLE, fso.SUBJECT_TITLE) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      inst_key,
      resolved_subject_title,
      fso.TERM_CODE
  ) distinct_subjects
  GROUP BY inst_key
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(ccs.CANON_SUBJECT_TITLE, fso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  fso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  -- prefer employee_directory email, else drupal_employee_directory email
  COALESCE(ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ded.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS INSTRUCTOR_EMAIL,
  COALESCE(spi.subjects_count, 0) AS SUBJECTS_PER_INSTRUCTOR
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, SECTION_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, MASTER_SUBJECT_ID

rows.question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.

WITH moira_list_detail_raw AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`,
    `LAST_UPDATE_DATE`,
    `COUNTER`
  FROM `moira_list_detail`
),
member_counts AS (
  -- counts per list, include lists with zero members
  SELECT ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
         COALESCE(m.cnt,0) AS NUM_MEMBERS
  FROM `moira_list` ml
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`, COUNT(DISTINCT `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`) AS cnt
    FROM moira_list_detail_raw
    GROUP BY `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  ) m ON m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT MIN(NUM_MEMBERS) AS min_cnt, MAX(NUM_MEMBERS) AS max_cnt
  FROM member_counts
),
owners_expanded AS (
  -- owners directly listed in moira_list_owner plus owners referenced by detail rows
  SELECT `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`, `MOIRA_LIST_OWNER`
  FROM `moira_list_owner`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dlo.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`, mlo.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER`

  JOIN `moira_list_owner` mlo ON dlo.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY` = mlo.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`
)

  ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,

  ml.`IS_PUBLIC`,
  ml.`IS_HIDDEN`,

WITH academic_term_basic AS (

  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)) AS total_people,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN (
      -- member matched to a responsible faculty MIT ID who taught in a summer term with financial aid year > 2001
      ats.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    ) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) END) AS faculty_in_list
FROM moira_list ml

  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

  ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
     OR (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NULL 
         AND TRIM(LOWER(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)) = TRIM(LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)))

  SELECT

    ON mdetail.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlist.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

building_floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(fl.floor_count,
             CASE WHEN fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(1, FLOOR(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS / NULLIF(10,0))) ELSE 0 END
    ) AS floor_count
  FROM `fac_building` fb
  LEFT JOIN (
    -- this subquery will fail if fac_floor doesn't exist; MySQL will allow it only if table exists.

    GROUP BY FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  ) fl ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fl.FAC_BUILDING_KEY

  FROM building_floor_counts bfc

rows.question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.

WITH subject_sections_instructors AS (
  SELECT
    csf.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID,
    csf.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    csf.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
    csf.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    csf.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    csf.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    csf.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    csf.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` csf
  WHERE csf.`SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
academic_term_codes AS (
  SELECT
    at.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    RIGHT(at.`TERM_CODE`, 2) AS TERM_SUFFIX,
    LEFT(at.`TERM_CODE`, 4) AS TERM_YEAR
  FROM `academic_terms` at
  WHERE at.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),
-- aggregate distinct instructors by term_code and subject_id
instructor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ss.TERM_CODE,
    ss.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,''), NULLIF(ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,''))) AS distinct_instructors
  FROM subject_sections_instructors ss
  WHERE ss.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE, ss.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- pick subjects offered this year and ensure term is FA or SP
subjects_this_year_terms AS (
  SELECT
    cso.*,
    RIGHT(cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, 2) AS TERM_SUFFIX,
    LEFT(cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, 4) AS TERM_YEAR
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` cso
  WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
    AND RIGHT(cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, 2) IN ('FA','SP')
)
SELECT
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- no explicit school table available; use department name as SCHOOL_NAME placeholder per original query guidance
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  s.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  -- COURSE_LEVEL field not present in schema; derive a course level from SUBJECT_NUMBER if available (leading digit), else NULL
  CASE
    WHEN s.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]' THEN LEFT(s.SUBJECT_NUMBER,1)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  s.TOTAL_UNITS AS TOTAL_UNITS,
  CASE WHEN s.TERM_SUFFIX = 'FA' THEN 'Fall' WHEN s.TERM_SUFFIX = 'SP' THEN 'Spring' END AS OFFERED_TERM,
  s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COALESCE(fall_ic.distinct_instructors, 0) AS DISTINCT_INSTRUCTORS_FALL,
  COALESCE(spring_ic.distinct_instructors, 0) AS DISTINCT_INSTRUCTORS_SPRING
FROM subjects_this_year_terms s
LEFT JOIN academic_term_codes at
  ON s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
-- join instructor counts for FALL of same year & same subject
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.distinct_instructors, LEFT(ic.TERM_CODE,4) AS TERM_YEAR
  FROM instructor_counts ic
  WHERE RIGHT(ic.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA'
) fall_ic
  ON fall_ic.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
  AND fall_ic.TERM_YEAR = s.TERM_YEAR
-- join instructor counts for SPRING of same year & same subject
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.distinct_instructors, LEFT(ic.TERM_CODE,4) AS TERM_YEAR
  FROM instructor_counts ic
  WHERE RIGHT(ic.TERM_CODE,2) = 'SP'
) spring_ic
  ON spring_ic.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
  AND spring_ic.TERM_YEAR = s.TERM_YEAR
-- Only include subjects that have at least one section in Fall or Spring for that same year.
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1

  CASE
    WHEN cc.IS_LECTURE_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 'Lecture'
    WHEN cc.IS_LAB_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 'Lab'
    WHEN cc.IS_RECITATION_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 'Recitation'
    WHEN cc.IS_DESIGN_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 'Design'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS room_usage,
  cc.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  -- course_level: prefer SUBJECT_NUMBER -> derive level; if SIS table available prefer sis_course_description (not present in provided schema),
  -- infer from SUBJECT_NUMBER: numeric prefix of subject_number (first 3 digits)
  CASE
    WHEN cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN
      CASE

        WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER,1,3) AS UNSIGNED) >= 100 THEN 'Upper'

  mt_counts.unique_meeting_times,

  cc.SUBJECT_CODE AS subject_code,

     CASE

Area and number of rooms should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.

WITH fac_rooms_by_organization AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.FLOOR,
    fr.ROOM,
    fr.AREA,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM fac_rooms fr
)
SELECT
  fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  -- FORMATTED_NAME: N-1 leading spaces where N = ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, capped at 5
  CONCAT(
    REPEAT(' ', LEAST(GREATEST(CAST(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS SIGNED) - 1, 0), 5)),
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
  ) AS FORMATTED_NAME,
  CASE WHEN fo.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' END AS ASSIGNABLE_STATUS,
  -- TOTAL_AREA: sum of room areas (rounded to nearest integer) formatted with commas
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(fr.AREA), 0)), 0) AS TOTAL_AREA,
  -- NUM_ROOMS: count of rooms formatted with commas
  FORMAT(COUNT(fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY), 0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
  -- AVG_ROOM_AREA: average area rounded to nearest integer and formatted; NULL if no rooms
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY) > 0 THEN FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(fr.AREA) / COUNT(fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY)), 0)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS AVG_ROOM_AREA
FROM fac_organization fo
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_by_organization fr
  ON fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')
GROUP BY

  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,

rows.question: For each course, list its title, name of the building of the course location, duration (in terms of days), and a running average of the duration (in terms of days) using a window of two preceding and two following courses (partitioned by academic year and sorted by course start date).

WITH courses AS (
  SELECT
    co.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    co.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    co.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    co.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    co.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    -- attempt to parse dates from FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES / MEET_TIME fields if present in schema;
    -- assume MEET_TIME holds a date range like 'YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD' or single date; try to extract start/end
    -- fallback: use COURSE_START and COURSE_END derived from LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE and WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE where available
    -- Use LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE as start and WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE as end when explicit dates not present
    NULLIF(co.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, '') AS COURSE_START_RAW,
    NULLIF(co.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') AS COURSE_END_RAW,
    -- convert raw strings to dates where possible (try common ISO format)
    STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(co.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ''), '%Y-%m-%d') AS COURSE_START_DATE,
    STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(co.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, ''), '%Y-%m-%d') AS COURSE_END_DATE,
    co.MEET_PLACE AS MEET_PLACE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered co
),
locations AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    BUILDING_KEY
  FROM buildings
),
courses_with_building AS (
  SELECT
    c.SECTION_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_CODE,
    c.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    -- choose start/end date: if parsed dates available use them, else NULL
    c.COURSE_START_DATE,
    c.COURSE_END_DATE,
    -- try to map MEET_PLACE to BUILDING_NUMBER directly
    l.BUILDING_NAME
  FROM courses c
  LEFT JOIN locations l
    ON c.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
    AND c.MEET_PLACE = l.BUILDING_NUMBER
),
durations AS (
  SELECT
    cw.SECTION_ID,
    cw.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cw.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    cw.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    cw.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    cw.BUILDING_NAME,
    -- compute duration in days when both dates exist; else NULL
    CASE
      WHEN cw.COURSE_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND cw.COURSE_END_DATE IS NOT NULL
      THEN DATEDIFF(cw.COURSE_END_DATE, cw.COURSE_START_DATE) + 1
      ELSE NULL
    END AS DURATION_DAYS,
    -- derive academic year from EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE (use as partition); fall back to NULL
    cw.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_PARTITION,
    cw.COURSE_START_DATE
  FROM courses_with_building cw
)

  d.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  d.SUBJECT_TITLE AS COURSE_TITLE,
  d.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING,
  d.DURATION_DAYS AS DURATION_IN_DAYS,
  -- running average over window of 2 preceding and 2 following courses partitioned by academic year (term code)
  AVG(d.DURATION_DAYS) OVER (
    PARTITION BY d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_PARTITION
    ORDER BY d.COURSE_START_DATE

  ) AS RUNNING_AVG_DURATION_DAYS
FROM durations d
ORDER BY d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_PARTITION, d.COURSE_START_DATE, d.SUBJECT_CODE

rows.question: From the 100 email lists with the most number of subscribers, list their names, their total number of subscribers, their public status, the name of the department with the most presence in the list, and the number of students from this department in the list.

WITH moira_list_members_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC AS IS_PUBLIC,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME,
    mld.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
  FROM moira_list_detail AS mld
  JOIN moira_list AS ml
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
-- total distinct subscribers per list (prefer MIT id when present else raw member)
list_totals AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)) AS total_subscribers
  FROM moira_list_members_normalized
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
-- derive department name per member by using tables available in the schema:
-- employee_directory (has DEPARTMENT_NAME), drupal_employee_directory (has HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE),
-- cis_course_catalog / course_catalog_subject_offered etc don't map to people so skip them.
member_departments AS (
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COALESCE(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ddr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, 'Unknown') AS member_department,
    COALESCE(m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS canonical_member
  FROM moira_list_members_normalized AS m
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory AS ed
    ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND ed.MIT_ID = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory AS ddr
    ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND ddr.MIT_ID = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  -- additionally try matching by full name or email when no MIT_ID is present
  LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory AS ddr_name_match
    ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NULL
    AND (ddr_name_match.FULL_NAME = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER OR ddr_name_match.EMAIL_ADDRESS = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
  -- coalesce to prefer the direct MIT-ID join department, then name/email match
  -- note: the SELECT COALESCE above will pick ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME first, then ddr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE,
  -- but include ddr_name_match's HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE via the COALESCE expression:
),
member_departments_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    md.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COALESCE(
      -- try employee_directory match first
      (SELECT ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM employee_directory ed WHERE ed.MIT_ID = md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID LIMIT 1),
      -- then drupal_employee_directory by MIT_ID
      (SELECT ddr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM drupal_employee_directory ddr WHERE ddr.MIT_ID = md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID LIMIT 1),
      -- then drupal_employee_directory by full name or email
      (SELECT ddr2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM drupal_employee_directory ddr2 WHERE ddr2.FULL_NAME = md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER OR ddr2.EMAIL_ADDRESS = md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER LIMIT 1),
      'Unknown'
    ) AS member_department,
    COALESCE(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS canonical_member
  FROM moira_list_members_normalized md
),
-- count distinct members per (list, department)
dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    member_department,
    COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_member) AS dept_count
  FROM member_departments_resolved
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY, member_department
),
-- pick top department per list (highest count, tie break by department name)
top_department_per_list AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    member_department AS top_department,
    dept_count AS top_department_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
      member_department,
      dept_count,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY ORDER BY dept_count DESC, member_department) AS rn
    FROM dept_counts
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
-- distinct list attributes
lists AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    IS_PUBLIC
  FROM moira_list_members_normalized
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME, IS_PUBLIC
)
SELECT
  l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS moira_list_name,
  lt.total_subscribers AS total_subscribers,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(l.IS_PUBLIC, '')) IN ('1','t','true','y','yes') THEN 'Public'
    WHEN l.IS_PUBLIC IS NULL OR l.IS_PUBLIC = '' THEN 'Unknown'
    ELSE 'Private'
  END AS is_public,
  td.top_department AS department_with_most_presence,
  COALESCE(td.top_department_count, 0) AS number_of_students_from_that_department
FROM lists AS l
JOIN list_totals AS lt USING (MOIRA_LIST_KEY)
LEFT JOIN top_department_per_list AS td USING (MOIRA_LIST_KEY)
ORDER BY lt.total_subscribers DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH library_instructor_course_assignments AS (
  SELECT
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    lci.COURSE_NAME AS COURSE_NAME,
    lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS CATALOG_YEAR,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
    lrmd.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    lrmd.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY AS LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
  JOIN library_course_instructor lci
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
)
SELECT
  combined.instructor_name AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT combined.course_id) AS NUM_UNIQUE_COURSES,
  SUM(combined.material_assign_count) AS TOTAL_MATERIAL_ASSIGNMENTS,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(combined.pub_year_count) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(SUM(combined.pub_year_sum) / SUM(combined.pub_year_count), 2)
  END AS AVG_PUBLICATION_YEAR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT combined.material_status) AS NUM_DISTINCT_STATUSES
FROM (
  -- library assignments (use the CTE directly)
  SELECT
    lia.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
    lia.COURSE_NAME AS course_id,
    1 AS material_assign_count,
    CASE WHEN lia.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lia.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS pub_year,
    CASE WHEN lia.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pub_year_count,
    CASE WHEN lia.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lia.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS pub_year_sum,
    lia.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status
  FROM library_instructor_course_assignments lia

  UNION ALL

  -- TIP assignments
  SELECT
    tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name,
    -- SECTION_ID does not exist in tip_subject_offered per schema; use SUBJECT_ID + EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE to build a course identifier
    CONCAT(tso.SUBJECT_ID, ':', COALESCE(tso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, '')) AS course_id,
    1 AS material_assign_count,
    CASE WHEN tm.YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(tm.YEAR AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS pub_year,
    CASE WHEN tm.YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pub_year_count,
    CASE WHEN tm.YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(tm.YEAR AS UNSIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS pub_year_sum,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status
  FROM tip_detail td
  JOIN tip_material tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status tms ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  JOIN tip_subject_offered tso
    ON td.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
    AND td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
) AS combined
GROUP BY combined.instructor_name
ORDER BY NUM_UNIQUE_COURSES DESC
